description: Angular component for an image gallery with list and grid modes, supporting image operations like upload, edit, delete, download, and embed, with routing and UI interactions.

classes.name: ImageGalleryComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing and displaying an image gallery with list and grid modes, supporting CRUD operations, routing, and user interactions.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes component, sets up data sources, routing parameters, and UI state.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions and observers on component destruction.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Sets up reactive search input handling and updates UI mode.

methods.name: includeSystemImagesChanged
methods.description: Handles change in include system images filter.

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Switches between list and grid display modes.

methods.name: updateMode
methods.description: Updates the UI based on current mode.

methods.name: initListMode
methods.description: Initializes list mode, including resize observer and routing subscriptions.

methods.name: updatePaginationSubscriptions
methods.description: Sets up subscriptions for pagination and sorting changes.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Clears selected images.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Fetches and updates image data based on current UI state.

methods.name: imageUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates to an image, refreshing the view.

methods.name: imageDeleted
methods.description: Handles removal of an image from the view.

methods.name: enterFilterMode
methods.description: Enables search filter input focus.

methods.name: exitFilterMode
methods.description: Disables search filter input.

methods.name: trackByEntity
methods.description: Track function for Angular ngFor optimization.

methods.name: isSystem
methods.description: Checks if an image is a system image.

methods.name: readonly
methods.description: Determines if an image is readonly based on user authority.

methods.name: deleteEnabled
methods.description: Checks if delete operation is enabled for an image.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes a single image with confirmation and error handling.

methods.name: deleteImages
methods.description: Deletes multiple selected images with confirmation and error handling.

methods.name: downloadImage
methods.description: Downloads an image.

methods.name: exportImage
methods.description: Exports an image.

methods.name: importImage
methods.description: Imports an image.

methods.name: selectImage
methods.description: Selects an image.

methods.name: rowClick
methods.description: Handles row click event, either editing or selecting images.

methods.name: uploadImage
methods.description: Opens dialog to upload a new image.

methods.name: editImage
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit an image or navigates to resource.

methods.name: embedImage
methods.description: Opens dialog to embed an image.

methods.name: updatedRouterParamsAndData
methods.description: Updates URL query parameters and refreshes data accordingly.
